# Zero to One Docs — LLMs / Agents

> Machine-oriented entry map. Human overview: OVERVIEW.md · Agent rules: AGENTS.md

## Primary entrypoints

- AGENTS.md — mandatory agent instructions
- OVERVIEW.md — repository map
- AGENT-ROUTING.md — topic → canonical markdown
- catalog/topics.yaml — structured topic index
- README.md — human landing + Quick Start
- QUICK-START.md — persona-based learning paths
- domains/README.md — 15 technical domains + maturity
- personal/README.md — private life-data OS (not curriculum)

## Knowledge areas

### Technical domains
- domains/ — AI/ML, backend, blockchain, game-dev, system-design, devops-sre, iot, web-dev, …
- challenges/ — deliberate practice aligned to domains

### Guides (non-code life & career)
- guides/01-mental-models/

- guides/04-lifestyle-os/ — well-being, hormones, Life OS theory
